I want to accept EVERYTHING gaming wise.. if its relevant in gaming, i want it. plain and simple.

I will be setting up a google form submission for users who are interested but for anyone interested in jumping in on this right now (i think the channel only has 4 subs lol) you can send a PM on that channel with the video link.

Enjoy your mornings!
